title: Wisconet API v1 Wrapper
text: rwisconet provides interface Wisconet v1 API (https://wisconet.wisc.edu/api/v1). Supports fetching station metadata, available field definitions, observation data one stations.

title: Wisconet API v1 Wrapper
code: remotes::install_github("bzbradford/rwisconet")

title: Wisconet API v1 Wrapper
text: Creating new client automatically fetches station field metadata API. Default timezone “America/Chicago” interpreting date/time ranges conversion UTC local time. can skip initial metadata fetch use different timezone. Normally .
code: suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse)) library(rwisconet)  wn <- Wisconet$new() wn #> <Wisconet API> #>   Timezone: America/Chicago  #>   Stations: 78  #>   Fields: 253 wn <- Wisconet$new(timezone = "US/Eastern", fetch_on_init = FALSE)
